resolution_order.description: Responsible-AI, audit, privacy, human-authority, abstention, and external-action controls.
Required object structure, component obligations, and baseline failure and side-effect rules.
Services, opportunity rules, staffing map, reviewer roles, and recommendation thresholds within permitted business criteria.

conflict_rule: When a lower-precedence layer conflicts with a higher-precedence layer, the higher-precedence requirement controls and the conflict is audited.
